title: 第1043章 摧枯拉朽二第1042章 摧枯拉朽一
content_zh:
山壁上那些之前还拼命冲击过旗幕的剑修们全部停下了动作。
有人失神一般将手中的剑“当啷”一声掉在地上，有人张着嘴却发不出任何声音，就连那些受伤倒地的剑修，都勉强支起身子，呆呆地望着场中那具跪倒的无头尸体。
陈越的眼眶猛地睁大，嘴角的血都忘了擦。
更远处，缥缈神宗那手持重锏的壮汉浑身僵在了原地。他的瞳孔缩成了针尖大小，手中的重锏几乎要握不住。
他看见了那一剑，他根本没看见是如何斩出去的，在他的感知里，余烬拔剑、挥剑、收剑，三个动作之间似乎没有任何时间间隔，那一瞬间，空间像被人折叠起来又展开，站在阵中的枯瘦老者明明与余烬相隔着一段距离，可那道剑光却像无视了一切规律。
而且，就在那一剑切过枯瘦老者脖颈的同时，壮汉清晰地感觉到一股异样的力量波动极其轻微地掠过，自己体内的通天修为像是被什么无形的东西掐住了咽喉，运转滞涩了虽然只有千分之一的刹那不到，连他一个念头转动的时间都远远不够，可对他而言却是一件非常诡异的事情!
不仅是这名通天初阶的壮汉，楚东流一样感觉到了不对劲，但是等他们回过神时，枯瘦老者的头已经落了地。
“你……你做了什么？”壮汉的声音从牙缝里挤出来，沙哑而颤抖。
余烬目光落在他身上，随即迈开步子，朝壮汉的方向走去。步伐依旧不快，靴子踩在碎石上发出轻微的咯吱声，在死寂的废墟中格外清晰。
“哼！”
楚东流冷哼一声，眼神阴沉，他再也顾不上什么体面，抬手便是一道大道光柱轰向余烬的后背，这一击方才险些击碎巨神之影。
他发出攻击的同时，身形甚至一折，从侧面迎着余烬截击而去。
感知到楚东流的动向，余烬却头也不回，他只是随手一挥，红银飞剑宛如两尊狙神往身后一甩。
一道银白、一道赤红，剑气纵横剑土内外，赤红杀剑精准地撞上了楚东流轰出的大道光柱，轰然炸开一团刺目光芒；银色芥子则以超绝的速度封住了楚东流前冲的路线，剑尖颤动着，悬停在他喉咙前三寸！
楚东流被迫硬生生刹住了脚步！
而余烬已经借着那一甩之势，脚步轻轻一踏，一步到了壮汉面前！
这一步踏出时，不是跨越空间，而是肉身极致速度的表现，他脚下那片区域的碎石齐齐化为粉末，整个人如流星般激射而至，速度快得连残影都捕捉不到。
好在缥缈神宗的壮汉终究是通天初阶的修士，多年战斗本能让他下意识架起重锏横在胸前，同时左拳裹着金光轰然砸出。
“轰——！”
拳锏在第一时间相交，明明只是手握重器，可壮汉只觉一股蛮横到不讲道理的巨力顺着锏身传遍整条右臂，那柄足有万钧沉的重锏竟然脱手飞出，在半空中旋转着插入数十丈外的剑土，没柄而入！

他甚至没来得及吃痛大叫，他的左拳与余烬的右拳已经正面碰撞，这一次发出一声沉闷如雷的炸响！
紧随其后一连串细密的“咔嚓”声！
壮汉的整条左臂从拳头开始、到手腕、到小臂、再到肘关节，骨骼寸寸碎裂，扭曲成一种令人牙酸的形状！
content_en:
All the sword cultivators on the mountain wall who had tried their best to attack the flag screen stopped.
Some people dropped their swords to the ground with a clang as if in a daze, others opened their mouths but could not make any sound. Even those sword cultivators who were injured and fell to the ground barely stood up and stared blankly at the kneeling headless corpse in the field.
Chen Yue's eyes widened suddenly, and he forgot to wipe the blood from the corners of his mouth.
Further away, the strong man holding a heavy mace from the Piaomiao Divine Sect froze on the spot. His pupils shrank to the size of a pinhead, and he could hardly hold the heavy weapon in his hand.
He saw the sword, but he didn't see how it was slashed out at all. In his perception, there seemed to be no time interval between the three actions of Yi Yan drawing the sword, swinging the sword, and sheathing the sword. At that moment, the space seemed to be folded and unfolded. The skinny old man standing in the formation was clearly separated from Yi Yan by a distance, but the sword light seemed to ignore all rules.
Moreover, just as the sword cut through the skinny old man's neck, the strong man clearly felt a strange wave of power passing by very slightly. The heavenly cultivation in his body seemed to be choked by something invisible, and its movement was stagnant. Although it was only less than one thousandth of an instant, and it was far from enough time for him to even think about it, it was a very strange thing for him!
Not only this strong man who was at the beginning of Heaven-reaching Level, but also Chu Dongliu felt something was wrong, but when they came to their senses, the skinny old man's head had already fallen to the ground.
"You...what did you do?" The strong man's voice was squeezed out from between his teeth, hoarse and trembling.
Yan Yan's eyes fell on him, and then he took steps towards the direction of the strong man. The pace is still not fast, and the slight crunching sound of the boots on the gravel is particularly clear in the dead ruins.
"Hmph!"
Chu Dongliu snorted coldly, his eyes were gloomy. He no longer cared about his dignity. He raised his hand and blasted a beam of light towards Yi Yan's back. This blow almost shattered the shadow of the giant god.
When he launched the attack, he even bent his body and attacked Ember from the side.
Sensing Chu Dongliu's movements, Yi Yan didn't look back. He just waved his hand casually, and the red and silver flying swords were swung behind him like two sniper gods.
One silvery white and one red red, the sword energy spread across the sword soil inside and outside. The red killing sword accurately hit the avenue light pillar blasted by Chu Dongliu, exploding into a ball of dazzling light; the silver mustard seed blocked Chu Dongliu's forward path at a super speed, and the tip of the sword trembled, hovering three inches in front of his throat!
Chu Dongliu was forced to stop abruptly!
And Yi Yan had already taken advantage of that swing to reach the strong man in front of him with a light step!
When this step was taken, it was not a leap across space, but a manifestation of the extreme speed of the body. The gravel in the area under his feet turned into powder, and the whole person shot up like a meteor, so fast that even the afterimage could not be caught.
Fortunately, the strong man of the Piaomiao Shen Sect was a monk at the beginning of Tongtian. Years of fighting instinct made him subconsciously place a heavy mace across his chest, and at the same time, his left fist was wrapped in golden light and smashed out.
"Boom——!"
The fists and maces met at the first moment. They were obviously just holding heavy weapons, but the strong man felt an unreasonable and arrogant force spread along the body of the mace throughout his entire right arm. The heavy mace flew out of his hand, spinning in mid-air and inserted into the sword soil dozens of feet away, entering without the handle!
He didn't even have time to scream in pain. His left fist collided head-on with Yan Yan's right fist, and this time there was a dull thunderous explosion!
Followed by a series of detailed "click" sounds!
The strong man's entire left arm, starting from the fist, to the wrist, to the forearm, and then to the elbow joint, the bones were shattered inch by inch and twisted into a shape that made people feel sad!
